choice.basis: The dashboard's y-axis is explicitly labeled 'Reported clean-grid share (%)'. In a bar chart, the vertical height of the bar is the primary visual encoding of the value on that axis. The Offshore wind bar is the tallest, reaching approximately 68 on the y-axis, whereas the Utility solar bar reaches approximately 40. Although the text annotations (41.2% vs 29.8%) are inconsistent with the bar heights, the geometric representation on the labeled axis is the standard method for determining magnitude in such charts. Therefore, Offshore wind is identified as the source with the largest contribution. The routing criterion is to send the largest source to priority contribution review.
choice.option_label: Route Offshore wind to priority contribution review
